div.head: II Cn 46
div.ab: Gif frigman riht fæsten abrece, gilde lahslit mid Denum, wite mid Englum, be þam þe seo dæd sy.
Gif frigman riht fæsten abrece, gilde lahslit mid Denum, wite mid Englum, be þam seo dæd sy.
Si liber legitimum ieiunium infringat, reddat láhslit cum Dacis, witam cum Anglis, secundum quod acciderit.
Be festene. Gyf friman riht fæsten abrece, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wite mid Englum, be ðam ðe seo deed sy.
Gif frigman rihtfæsten abrece, gilde lahslit mid Denum, wite mid Englum, be þam þe seo dæd sy.
(Vom Fasten. B) Wenn ein Freier gesetzliches Fasten bricht, zahle er Rechtsbruchbusse bei den Dänen, Strafgeld bei den Engländern, je nachdem die That ist.
(Of fasting. B) If a free man breaks a lawful fast, let him pay lahslit among the Danes, a fine among the English, according to what the deed is.
Concerning fasts. If a freeman breaks a legally ordained fast, he shall pay lahslit in a Danish district, a fine in an English one, according to the nature of the offence.
If a free man break a legally appointed fast, he is to pay lahslit among the Danes, a fine among the English, in proportion to the deed.
If a freeman breaks a legally mandated fast, he must pay lahslit within the Danelaw and a penalty among the English, according to the nature of the deed.
